en.t: Winter had ended, spring had returned, and the New Year had come again.

units.source_text: 明石女御的产期迫近了，故自正月朔日开始，不断诵经，以祈祷安产。

en.t: Lady Akashi's time to give birth was drawing near, so from the first day of the first month, sutras were recited without cease to pray for a safe delivery.

units.source_text: 举办法事的寺庙，其数不可胜计。

en.t: The temples holding rites for her were too many to count.

units.source_text: 源氏从前见过葵夫人因产而死，故对此事非常害怕，心甚忧虑。

en.t: Genji had once seen Lady Aoi die in childbirth, so he was deeply frightened by this matter and terribly anxious at heart.

units.source_text: 紫夫人不曾生产，一方面说来是一件憾事，而且眼前寂寞；

en.t: That Lady Murasaki had never borne a child was, in one sense, a regret, and it left his present life feeling lonely;

units.source_text: 但另一方面说来，又是一件幸事。

en.t: but from another point of view, it was also a blessing.

units.source_text: 且明石女御年龄还很幼小，生产是否平安，他早已非常担心。

en.t: Moreover, Lady Akashi was still very young, and he had long been deeply worried about whether the birth would be safe.

units.source_text: 到了二月里，明石女御的气色大有变化，身上颇感痛苦，大家心中惶恐不安。

en.t: By the second month, Lady Akashi's complexion had changed greatly, she was in considerable physical distress, and everyone was fearful and uneasy.

units.source_text: 阴阳师进言：为谨慎计，宜迁居他处。

en.t: The diviners advised that, as a precaution, she ought to move somewhere else.

units.source_text: 但倘迁居六条院外，则相隔太远，很不放心。

en.t: But if she moved outside the Rokujo estate, the distance would be too great, and they could not feel at ease.

units.source_text: 于是决定迁往明石夫人所居西北院中厅的厢屋。

en.t: So it was decided that she would move to the side chamber of the central hall in the northwest residence where Lady Akashi lived.

units.source_text: 这里的厢屋只有两大间，外面围着走廊。

en.t: This side chamber had only two large rooms, with a corridor running around the outside.

units.source_text: 立刻在这里修建法坛，聘请许多道行高深的僧人来，大声念经祈祷。

en.t: A ritual altar was immediately set up there, and many highly virtuous monks were invited to come and chant sutras loudly in prayer.

units.source_text: 母亲明石夫人想起此事之安危与自己命运之穷通有关，心中非常焦灼。

en.t: Her mother, Lady Akashi, reflected that the success or danger of this event was bound up with the rise or fall of her own fate, and her heart was filled with intense anxiety.
